description: A small white cabinet-like box sits on the tabletop in front of you, with your left hand resting near the middle and your right hand closer to the box. The right hand moves left to the cabinet, presses and then pulls a front panel so the cabinet door swings open, reaches briefly inside as if checking the interior, then withdraws and shifts right to set a small block down on the table; the left hand stays mostly still and does not touch any object.
